question: List all product categories.
sql: SELECT id, name FROM categories ORDER BY name

question: Show the 10 most expensive products.
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which customers are from Canada?
sql: SELECT id, name, country FROM customers WHERE country = 'Canada'

question: Show all returned orders.
sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned' ORDER BY order_date DESC

question: Which products cost less than $10?
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price < 10 ORDER BY price

question: Show the 5-star reviews for product 247.
sql: SELECT id, customer_id, created_at FROM reviews WHERE product_id = 247 AND rating = 5

question: List pending orders that have not shipped yet.
sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND shipped_date IS NULL ORDER BY order_date

question: Which payments were made with a gift card?
sql: SELECT id, order_id, paid_at, amount FROM payments WHERE method = 'gift_card' ORDER BY paid_at DESC LIMIT 20

question: How many customers do we have in each country?
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC

question: What is the total revenue by product category?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: What is the average order value?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'

question: How many orders are there for each status?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: What is the average rating per product category?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

question: Which payment method is used most often?
sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments GROUP BY method ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total sales by customer country?
sql: SELECT cu.country, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY cu.country ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Who are the top 10 customers by total spend?
sql: SELECT cu.name, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spend FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY cu.id, cu.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 10

question: What are the 5 best-selling products by units sold?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the total number of items sold?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'

question: Which products have an average rating above 4.5 with at least 5 reviews?
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND AVG(r.rating) > 4.5 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

question: What is the average profit margin percentage by category?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(AVG((p.price - p.cost) / p.price) * 100, 1) AS avg_margin_pct FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_margin_pct DESC

question: List the products and quantities in order 1001.
sql: SELECT p.name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.line_total FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 1001

question: Show the customer name and total for the 10 most recent orders.
sql: SELECT cu.name, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which customers have never placed an order?
sql: SELECT cu.id, cu.name FROM customers cu LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.id WHERE o.id IS NULL

question: Which products have never been ordered?
sql: SELECT p.id, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL

question: Show the lowest-rated reviews with product name.
sql: SELECT p.name, r.rating, r.created_at FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.rating = 1 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 20

question: Show recent payments with the customer name and country.
sql: SELECT cu.name, cu.country, pay.method, pay.amount, pay.paid_at FROM payments pay JOIN orders o ON o.id = pay.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY pay.paid_at DESC LIMIT 20

question: What category is product 1 in?
sql: SELECT p.name AS product, c.name AS category FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = 1

question: How many orders were placed last month?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-11-01' AND order_date < '2025-12-01'

question: What was the total revenue last quarter?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND order_date < '2025-10-01' AND status != 'cancelled'

question: Show monthly order counts for 2025.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: What is the month-over-month revenue change in 2025?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 1) AS pct_change FROM m ORDER BY month

question: How many new customers signed up in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01' AND signup_date < '2026-01-01'

question: What is the average number of days between order and shipment?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(shipped_date) - julianday(order_date)), 2) AS avg_days_to_ship FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NOT NULL

question: Which orders took more than 4 days to ship?
sql: SELECT id, order_date, shipped_date, CAST(julianday(shipped_date) - julianday(order_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_to_ship FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND julianday(shipped_date) - julianday(order_date) > 4 ORDER BY days_to_ship DESC

question: Show orders placed in the last 30 days.
sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, status, total_amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('2025-12-31', '-29 days') ORDER BY order_date DESC

question: How many days since each of the top 5 customers last ordered?
sql: SELECT cu.name, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order, CAST(julianday('2025-12-31') - julianday(MAX(o.order_date)) AS INTEGER) AS days_since FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY cu.id, cu.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the total revenue per year?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: What was the revenue in each quarter of 2025?
sql: SELECT 'Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

question: Which products were listed in the last 6 months?
sql: SELECT name, created_at FROM products WHERE created_at >= date('2025-12-31', '-6 months') ORDER BY created_at DESC

question: How many reviews were written in each month of 2025?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: What is the total revenue from the Electronics category in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND o.status != 'cancelled'
